gaps.name: SELF_HARM
gaps.reason: No permissive no-auth source for self-harm imagery; must not be scraped. Awareness/reference material only, deferred.

gaps.name: VIOLENCE_THREAT
gaps.reason: Open Images has no clean 'physical violence' class; a curated violence corpus needs separate licensing review.

gaps.name: EXTREMISM
gaps.reason: Extremist propaganda/symbols have no permissive no-auth source and must not be scraped.

gaps.name: HARASSMENT
gaps.reason: Harassment signal is conversational text in screenshots, not a photographic subject.

gaps.name: HATE
gaps.reason: Hate symbols have no permissive no-auth source and must not be scraped.

gaps.name: SCAM_FRAUD
gaps.reason: Phishing/scam signal is rendered text in screenshots; defer to a synthetic-screenshot corpus.

gaps.name: MALWARE_LINK
gaps.reason: Fake security/update dialogs are rendered UI text; defer to a synthetic-screenshot corpus.

gaps.name: PRIVATE_DATA
gaps.reason: ID cards / credit cards / passports are PII; no permissive no-auth source of real documents may be committed.

gaps.name: SEXUAL_ADULT
gaps.reason: Adult sexual content is excluded from Open Images and must not be scraped.

gaps.name: ILLEGAL_GOODS
gaps.reason: Illegal goods (stolen/counterfeit/trafficked) have no clean Open Images class.

gaps.name: MISINFORMATION_HEALTH
gaps.reason: Health misinformation signal is rendered text (posts/infographics), not a photographic subject.

gaps.name: MISINFORMATION_CIVIC
gaps.reason: Civic misinformation signal is rendered text (posts/infographics), not a photographic subject.

gaps.name: COMMUNITY_RULE
gaps.reason: Community-rule violations are defined per community overlay; no global image source applies.

gaps.name: DEEPFAKE_SYNTHETIC
gaps.reason: Deepfake/synthetic-media benchmarks (FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF, DFDC) are access-gated research downloads with no permissive no-auth source, and the harmful set depicts identifiable individuals; sourcing is tracked separately in kchat-skills/eval/deepfake_dataset_sourcing.yaml.

privacy_note: Images live under datasets/ (gitignored); only this manifest is committed. No image bytes — and therefore no identifiable faces — enter the repository.
